title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-09-16
lineage: LP>WAV>WAV>FLAC (Lyra Helikon phono cartridge, Linn LP12/Lingo turntable, Linn Ittok tonearm, Audioquest LeoPard tonearm cable, PS Audio PS2 preamplifier, Kimber PBJ interconnect, M-Audio Audiophile USB A/D converter)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the Dead’s tight early‑1966 performance, with standout tracks like “Stealin’” and “Lindy”.
ai_review.review: These reviews rave about a crisp, low‑hiss soundboard recording that brings out the sharp, clean guitar licks and vocal harmonies of the band at its earliest.  Listeners highlight the tight playing and classic early‑Dead songs – especially “Stealin’” and “Lindy” – calling the set essential listening for anyone interested in 1966 material.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are largely enthusiastic, noting both superb musical performance and high‑quality audio; the few lower‑star comments do not detract from the overall consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp treble, very little hiss or clicking, sharp and clean instrument separation; listeners say this version sounds superior to other releases.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early demo‑style set that showcases the Dead at their tightest in 1966; energetic and well‑structured, capturing the classic early sound.
